name: Kody Technolab Ltd.
summary: Kody Technolab Ltd. is a deep tech company that provides AI-powered robots, AI solutions, and scalable platforms for automation across diverse industries. The company's core services encompass robotics development, AI and machine learning development, computer vision development, Internet of Things (IoT) solutions, VisionOS app development, legacy solution migration, IT consulting services, and custom software development. They also offer website and mobile application development and testing services. Kody Technolab develops various AI-powered autonomous robots, including serving robots like Dasher and Odigo, surveillance robots, advertising robots, health screening robots, and heavy-duty cleaning robots such as Vulcan. The company is a key player in the Indian robotics industry, focusing on innovations like voice-assisted serving robots, surveillance robots, and floor cleaning robots. Through a joint venture called Falcon Tech Robotics LLC in Abu Dhabi, Kody Technolab also manufactures robotic solutions for the Middle Eastern market, including defense, surveillance, experiential marketing, hospitality, and cleaning robots. Kody Technolab targets businesses across various sectors, assisting them with digital transformation, automation, and improving efficiency, agility, and market competitiveness. They have a global client base, having delivered over 250 projects to clients in more than 30 countries. The company focuses on emerging technologies including artificial intelligence, machine learning, and robotics.
